# Förvaltaren om tyska jätten: ”Finns otroliga värden i bolaget”

**Feed**: borslunch  
**Published**: 2026-09-04  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

In this Friday Börslunch episode, fund managers Peter van Berlekom (Esperia) and Jon Annell (Von Euler & Partners) expect the stock market to move mostly sideways. They see AI-driven earnings revisions as the main support and rising long-term rates as the main risk. They discuss Broadcom's strong report, Nvidia/AI flows, Sectra's strong report (Fundamental Research is preferred as cheaper), Volkswagen's 50,000 job cuts and sum-of-parts value, Tesla's robotaxi push, Polestar's collapse, the Volvo Cars vs AB Volvo share performance, and Nordea's view that Clas Ohlson has become too expensive.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 AVGO — Broadcom | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Guest owns it; excellent report, strong backlog, valuation 18-19x falling to 13x

#### Reasoning

Peter van Berlekom (guest, Esperia) owns Broadcom. He called the report excellent despite softer Q4 guidance, and highlighted the backlog from Google, OpenAI and Anthropic plus diversification into cybersecurity and enterprise, which lowers risk versus Nvidia. The valuation falls from 18-19x next year to 13x the following year. He is not worried as long as growth holds.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI growth slows materially
- if the backlog weakens
- if expectations become too high relative to growth

> *"På nästa år handlas den på 18–19 gånger vinsten. Det där kryper ner till 13 året efter. Så länge tillväxten håller i sig så... är jag inte ett dugg orolig."*

---

### 🟠 SECT-B — Sectra | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Very strong report, but the guest has not followed it; margins not as standout as expected; seen as expensive

#### Reasoning

Peter admits he hasn't followed Sectra. On a quick look he says margins are good but don't stand out as much as he expected, and he would rather own the cheaper Fundamental Research. The report was strong, with rollouts in US/Canada/UK and a shift toward recurring revenue, but Europe's cloud hesitancy is a headwind.

#### Sell Triggers

- if European cloud adoption keeps lagging
- if valuation stays stretched

> *"Goda marginaler, men det sticker inte ut så mycket som jag trodde."*

---

### 🟠 VOW3 — Volkswagen | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Incredible value in the parts, a good CEO and cost cuts, but a breakup/value unlock is uncertain and unions complicate it

#### Reasoning

Guest (Peter) sees incredible hidden value, praises the CEO, and says the market rewards the 50,000 job cuts. However, sum-of-parts value is hard to realise, the timing of any breakup is unknowable, German production is the problem, and Asian competition persists. Jon says more is needed. No buy advice given.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the breakup never happens
- if German production margins fail to improve
- if Chinese competition intensifies

> *"Det finns ju otroliga värden i det där bolaget, men svårt att materialisera."*

---

### ⛔ PSNY — Polestar | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Down 28% in one day, -98% overall; regulatory problems as a Chinese-classed brand

#### Reasoning

The guest calls it a real catastrophe: the stock is down roughly 98% and it faces regulatory issues because it is classed as Chinese, making its cars hard to sell.

> *"Polestar var en riktig katastrof igår."*

---

### 🟡 CLAS-B — Clas Ohlson | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Nordea analyst says too expensive; guest sees fair value with limited excess return

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst Niklas Skog (Nordea) says the stock has become too expensive. Guest Peter agrees it is reasonably valued after strong years and doubts it will deliver excess return from here: 'fair here somewhere'.

#### Sell Triggers

- if valuation expands further
- if earnings momentum stalls

> *"Jag har svårt att tro att den skulle ge nån sorts allmän meravkastning från nu, men det är väl fair här nånstans."*

---

### 🟠 BMW — BMW | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Neue Klasse iX3 selling very well; worth running the numbers on

#### Reasoning

The guest highlights BMW's Neue Klasse rollout and the strong iX3 sales, and warns against underestimating Germany's ability to change. He does not expect a return to 10% margins in the short term.

#### Sell Triggers

- if iX3 demand fades
- if margins stay depressed

> *"Det låter som att det är nåt som är värt att räkna på."*

---
